text:
Type: off-white balance-arm desk lamp
Use: task light for working or reading at a desk; home office, study, bedroom
Style: industrial, retro, farmhouse
Materials: off-white lacquered steel shade, arm and round base, brass-coloured joints and fittings, braided black and white textile cord
Colors: warm off-white, brass gold, black and white
Shape: bell shade on a long horizontal balance arm pivoting on a brass ball joint over a straight upright, round weighted base, adjustable, medium size
Feel: charming, vintage, studious, warm
Goes with: wood desks, white walls, brass accents; farmhouse, industrial or Scandinavian home offices

product.name: RANARP
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm and head are adjustable.
